SELECT CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM matches) AS average_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
)
SELECT
  batter,
  ROUND(100.0 * boundary_runs / total_runs, 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM batter_stats
WHERE total_runs >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT batter
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
)

SELECT
  bowler,
  COUNT(*) AS ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL
   OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  batter,
  SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH first_innings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
),
batting_second_wins AS (
  SELECT m.winner
  FROM matches AS m
  JOIN first_innings AS f
    ON m.id = f.match_id
  WHERE m.winner IS NOT NULL
    AND m.winner <> f.batting_team
)
SELECT winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM batting_second_wins
GROUP BY winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(total_runs) AS total_powerplay_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

SELECT
  batter,
  SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  batter,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(batsman_runs) / SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type = 'wides' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 2) AS strike_rate
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH batter_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs = 4 OR batsman_runs = 6 THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
)
SELECT 
    batter,
    ROUND(100.0 * boundary_runs / total_runs, 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM batter_runs
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') OR extras_type IS NULL
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, CAST(SUM(batsman_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1
